# AntCat

> AntCat (https://www.antcat.org) is the online catalog of the ants of the world: valid names, synonyms, taxonomic history and references. AntWeb (https://www.antweb.org), the specimen and image database, uses AntCat's names.

This file is for programs and AI agents that want AntCat's data. Please read it before you send requests. The same guidance is at https://www.antcat.org/v1 in JSON.

## How to get data

- Use the API, not the web pages. Do not crawl or scrape the website for data; robots.txt applies.
- API: https://www.antcat.org/v1 (for example https://www.antcat.org/v1/taxa/429011)
- Documentation: https://www.antcat.org/api_docs
- Wait for each answer before sending the next request. Free registered API keys are coming; they will raise the limits. When you reach a limit the API answers HTTP 429 with how long to wait; please slow down instead of retrying at once.

## What we ask

- Use the API to answer research questions. Systematic extraction of the whole catalog, a mirror or full synchronization must be arranged in advance with antcat@antcat.org.
- Bulk data is not available automatically. For a larger project, write to antcat@antcat.org; AntCat is developed under the scientific leadership of Brian L. Fisher, who welcomes collaboration.
- Cite AntCat: Bolton, B. <year>. An online catalog of the ants of the world. Available from https://antcat.org. (accessed <date>)
- AntCat data are licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The access limits do not change the rights the licence grants.

## Specimens and images

- For specimens, images and distribution, use AntWeb: https://www.antweb.org/llms.txt

## Contact

- antcat@antcat.org
